metadata.description: The @dereekb/trello/node entry (rollup, inferred from rollup.config.cjs): compiles into dist/packages/trello/node and is named by the parent's `./node` export. The node-only file-system helpers of the board loop kit (attachment sync, block-preserving markdown writes): it imports node:fs and node:path but neither yargs nor @dereekb/dbx-cli, so a library such as dbx-claude can import it without the CLI's runtime. An explicit edge to trello:build-base, NOT `^build`: `^build` would resolve to trello:build, which depends on this very target -- a hard cycle. util is another family, so its ROOT `build` is the edge (the finalized copy TypeScript resolves `exports` against). The parent's `build` aggregates this target, so the entry point has no `build` of its own.
